description: This file contains utility functions for benchmarking PyTorch models, including compilation, execution speed, tensor core configuration, and reporting via table display.

methods.name: None _enable_tensor_cores()
methods.description: Enables tensor cores and sets float32 matrix multiplication precision to high if supported.

methods.name: None _disable_tensor_cores()
methods.description: Resets float32 matrix multiplication precision to default.

methods.name: bench_loop( model: torch.nn.Module | Callable, sample_input: torch.Tensor | Any, num_iters: int = 5, optimizer: torch.optim.Optimizer | None = None, loss_fn: Callable | None = None, )
methods.description: Runs a specified number of iterations to benchmark the execution time of a model or function, optionally in training mode.

methods.name: benchmark_compile( model: torch.nn.Module | Callable, sample_input: torch.Tensor | Any, num_iters: int = 5, backend: str | None = None, mode: str | None = "default", optimizer: torch.optim.Optimizer | None = None, loss_fn : torch.nn.Module | Callable | None = None, )
methods.description: Benchmarks the compilation and execution time of a model with optional backend and mode settings.

methods.name: bench_all( model : torch.nn.Module | Callable, sample_input: torch.Tensor | Any, num_iters : int = 5, optimizer: torch.optim.Optimizer | None = None, loss_fn : torch.nn.Module | Callable | None = None, )
methods.description: Runs comprehensive benchmarks across backends and modes, generating comparison tables for inference or training workflows.
